Name: Softer Snow Footstep Sound
Author: KatiKnitt
Description:
[size=4][size=4][b]What does the sound effect sound like?[/b][/size]
[size=2]Here's a demo video comparing the original and the modded snow footstep sound:[/size]

[youtube]JV1jJyUO1z8[/youtube][/size][size=2]
[/size]
[b][size=4]Dependencies[/size][/b]
This mod uses the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767?tab=files]Sound Tweaker[/url] mod, which in turn requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿ (Older versions before 1.1.0 use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232]Sound Effect Replacement[/url] mod, which had the same dependencies.)

[b][size=4]Install[/size]
[/b]   1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]. (You can find guide on how to install SMAPI [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]here[/url].)
   2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767?tab=files]Sound Tweaker[/url] and this mod.
   3. Unzip all three mod folders into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
   4. Run the game using SMAPI.


Big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url], who made a whole new sound replacement mod to make sound randomization possible!

Downloads.Description:
Changes:
- Mod is now working with the Sound Tweaker mod instead.
- Swapped single sound effect with 12 sound effects that are randomly played for a more natural stepping experience.
